items.headline: Will Stein says it's time for Kentucky's vision to become reality
items.description: Stein joins The Paul Finebaum Show ahead of the Wildcats' matchup against the Crimson Tide to discuss how Kentucky can build on last week's win and lean on Big Blue Nation.

items.headline: SEC Nation duo insist Kentucky will keep things interesting vs. Alabama
items.description: Chase Daniel calls out Bama's rushing needs and praises Will Stein's "NFL-style plays" as Matt Barrie adds how the young coach has "brought some fire" to the UK program.

items.headline: Bill Connelly's Week 2 preview: Big Ten-SEC challenge, early conference tests
items.description: Bluebloods have a chance at the early-season's biggest win. Big 12 and SEC have early conference challenges, and the G6 has an elimination weekend.

items.headline: Can Kentucky turn SEC opener vs. Alabama into a signature win?
items.description: The SEC Now crew breaks down Kentucky's chance for a signature win under Will Stein and how QBs Kenny Minchey and Keelon Russell could handle the pressure of the SEC opener.

items.headline: Stein urges Big Blue Nation to hold nothing back vs. No. 12 Alabama
items.description: Will Stein wants fans to bring disruption from warmups through the final whistle when UK hosts Bama and deliver the "loudest game in the history of Kentucky football."

items.headline: SEC matchup features No. 12 Alabama against Kentucky
items.description: No. 12 Alabama (1-0) at Kentucky (1-0), Sept. 12 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.
